llm_response.reason: The website uses the name and design style of the well-known 'Tom Ford' brand but provides almost no company information, mixes languages in an unusual way, and has SSL certificate problems. The product categories cover a wide range of high-value goods (clothes, perfumes, accessories), mimicking legitimate high-fashion e-commerce sites. The failed WHOIS/RDAP lookup is strongly indicative of a site hiding its ownership or operating illicitly. These match the following scam characteristics: spoofed brand, non-existent company info, ambiguous privacy practices, SSL issues, and multiple product categories.
